column1: # Phase O migration 1005 (DESIGN.md 6.3, section 8): old_key<TAB>new_key. A key is a holder id or holder.option.
# Holder names are the Q11 defaults (DECISIONS-coding-0355): descriptive Apex names, no collisions. Reversible.
# The holders use the new ids in code (renames pass, 28 Oct); 1005 moves saved settings from the old ids.
# Data holders (STORAGE folder) are renamed like settings holders. Chat filter ids (sh-frozen-treasure -> frozen-treasure,
# sh-far-deaths -> far-deaths) were renamed in code too; they are never saved, so there is nothing for 1005 to move.
